title: Exercise the contended local append-lock timeout with a live deadline
outcome: Exercise the contended local append-lock timeout with a live deadline
acceptance: A test holds the worker's append gate, calls the fatal append path with a positive controlled deadline, and proves the actual WouldBlock/wait branch returns TimedOut before the worker releases the gate
The test preserves the bounded watchdog, no-hang, no-I/O and ordinary-emit semantics and runs deterministically without real sleeps beyond the bounded deadline
